SAS task first. The R name follows where there is a close equivalent.

::: {.topic-index}

::: {.topic-group}
::: {.topic-cat}
Basics
:::

- [Create or change columns](mutate.qmd) DATA step assignment -> `mutate`
- [Keep, drop, and rename columns](select-rename.qmd) `KEEP` / `DROP` / `RENAME` -> `select` / `rename`
- [Keep rows that match a condition](filter.qmd) `WHERE` / subsetting `IF` -> `filter`
- [Conditional values](if-else-case-when.qmd) `IF-THEN` / `IFN` / `IFC` -> `if_else` / `case_when`
- [First non-missing](coalesce.qmd) `COALESCE` / `coalescec` -> `coalesce`
- [Convert character, numeric, and date](type-convert.qmd) `PUT` / `INPUT` -> `as.character` / `as.numeric` / `as.Date`
:::

::: {.topic-group}
::: {.topic-cat}
Text
:::

- [Extract part of a character value](substr.qmd) `SUBSTR` -> `substr`
- [Change text case](text-case.qmd) `UPCASE` / `LOWCASE` / `PROPCASE` -> `toupper` / `tolower` / `toTitleCase`
:::

::: {.topic-group}
::: {.topic-cat}
Dates
:::

- [Study day](study-day.qmd) `--DY` date subtraction
- [Partial dates](partial-dates.qmd) impute year-only or year-month (ADaM)
:::

::: {.topic-group}
::: {.topic-cat}
Combining Data
:::

- [Merge on keys](joins.qmd) `MERGE` / SQL `JOIN` -> `*_join`
- [Stack datasets](bind-rows.qmd) `SET` -> `bind_rows`
- [Transpose rows and columns](transpose.qmd) `PROC TRANSPOSE` -> `pivot_longer` / `pivot_wider`
:::

::: {.topic-group}
::: {.topic-cat}
Derivations
:::

- [Within-subject sequence](seq.qmd) `--SEQ` -> `row_number`
- [Last observation before exposure](lobxfl.qmd) `--LOBXFL`
:::

:::
